definitions.explanation: The fifth month of the year. Features Golden Week, Japan's longest holiday period.

examples.japanese: {五月|ごがつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{五月|ごがつ}{五日|いつか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{子|こ}ども→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{五月|ごがつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{五月|ごがつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{終|お}わり→終わり：01361_owari⟧⟦ごろ→頃：00932_goro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It starts to rain more toward the end of May.

examples.japanese: {五月|ごがつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There are many holidays in May, so a lot of people go on trips.

notes:
{五月|ごがつ} is the fifth month of the year.

JAPANESE MONTHS:
All months use number + ⟦{月|がつ}→月：02230_tsuki⟧:
- ⟦{一月|いちがつ}→一月：00631_ichigatsu⟧ (January) through ⟦{十二月|じゅうにがつ}→十二月：00636_juunigatsu⟧ (December)

GOLDEN WEEK HOLIDAYS:
- ⟦{昭和|しょうわ}→昭和：28079_shouwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (April 29): Showa Day
- ⟦{憲法|けんぽう}→憲法：02744_kenpou⟧⟦{記念|きねん}→記念：00232_kinen⟧⟦{日|び}→日：02249_hi⟧ (May 3): Constitution Day
- ⟦みどり→緑：00970_midori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (May 4): Greenery Day
- ⟦{子|こ}ども→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (May 5): Children's Day

MAY TRADITIONS:
- ⟦{鯉|こい}のぼり→鯉のぼり：05711_koinobori⟧: carp streamers (displayed for Children's Day)
- ⟦{柏餅|かしわもち}→柏餅：19485_kashiwamochi⟧: rice cakes wrapped in oak leaves
- ⟦{五月人形|ごがつにんぎょう}→五月人形：27110_gogatsuningyou⟧: warrior dolls

SEASON:
May is late spring (⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧) with pleasant weather. The rainy season (⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧) typically begins in late May or early June.
